question: From the same full pre23/P4 input, compare frozen first-raw allocation with online re-selection of three held80ms commands until each parent own official finish, typed stop or equal predeclared200-action cap.

prior_evidence.scope: One hold only; does not certify future path safety or whole-lap improvement

Each candidate once and only selected candidate repeated independently; still fails current space even without assuming early stops/dedup.

selected.reason: Same200-action cap for both parents gives16s after physical pre23=2.78s (up to18.78s). Space leaves reserve512MiB plus additional headroom; enough horizon to attempt own finish, never guaranteed. Cap exhaustion is SCOPE_CENSORED, not completion or inferred gain.

policy.domain: Every current safe nonterminal model parent in FIRST_LAP or FINISH_CONFIRM from fixed pre23; no location/index/fixture trigger, no learned lookup, no new reference/steering/phase law.
policy.baseline: Frozen477/476 first-raw minimax only, qstar recomputed once from its own current wheels at each80ms boundary; no three-command rescue.
policy.online: Call SourceC once at each current80ms boundary; preserve before and after-nominal memory, full state/full ForecastLedger/RNG/P4nodes/finish history. Compute frozen476 qstar once. Candidate commands preserve the same complete nominal float32 steering and inactive pedal0, varying only original active pedal among q0/qstar/+0. Both inactive -> one complete command.
policy.dedup: Deduplicate only identical complete IEEE754 float32 command bit patterns with stable provenance aliases. No near-equality/different steering merge. Worst counts assume all3distinct and one separate selected repeat even if aliases occur.
policy.hold: Unchanged source80ms hold,4raw20ms and no within-hold controller update. Only original source official finish/termination may legally end at1..4raw; record actual length and repeat all produced raw exactly, never pad/step after terminal.
policy.valid: Every produced raw passes original physical guard, original progress ledger/deadline and phase/finish checks. No future-safe claim from M80. A terminal non-finish candidate is ineligible.
policy.score: Exact max over actually produced raw and four wheels of max(0,force_ratio-1), finite/nonnegative per-value check. Among valid candidates minimum exact score, exact ties largest original active pedal; no epsilon/weights/new branch/new braking.
policy.selection_repeat: Evaluate each distinct candidate ONCE in a fresh restored world. Choose from those scores. Repeat ONLY the selected complete command in a separate fresh restored world. Require identical full raw trace, command/memory/phase/RNG/ledger/status/terminal event and observed raw length. No second scores for unselected candidates.
policy.own_dispatch: Shadow/repeat worlds use prepared AFTER nominal memory and original BEFORE nominal field without SourceC.act. Restore full ForecastLedger BEFORE Stream. Parent stamp of full physical/memory/ledger/RNG/reference/rows/status stays exact after every forecast; no forecast commits it. Only then apply selected command to same live parent using prepared nominal/before once; check its own hold against selected prediction under existing source tolerances and exact discrete flags. Only own official physical finish permits parent DONE; preserve separate after-nominal and legitimate after-DONE memory.
policy.empty: No valid candidate => EMPTY_FINITE_CANDIDATE_DOMAIN; no parent rescue/extra command. Failure is about these3commands, not all controls.
policy.lookahead_limit: M80 does not constrain cumulative heading/velocity/path error or certify safety after current hold. Re-selection every boundary can still become unsafe/empty/infeasible later.

validation.ranking_uncertainty: Retain all one-pass scores, validity/status, best-second and qstar gaps, selected repeat equality and own-vs-selected errors per query. No invented confidence interval or epsilon. Warm-start/contact/island state is omitted from exports; cold-vs-own source uncertainty remains. No unselected warm counterfactual is observed, so do NOT infer a0.10 two-command live gap bound or proven live-optimal ordering from one selected join. No extra warm qstar probe is authorized.
validation.pending_history: Old PendingParent436 recipe whitelist accepts nominal/fullgas/neutralbrake histories and is not an authority for new qstar/zero histories. validation.finish: Whole parents retain pre23 episode root clockmap/tracker history. validation.technical: Source hash/restore/phase/numeric/RNG/isolation/selected-repeat/own join error stops dependent experiment globally, preserves charged partial records, no retry/tolerance widening. Unsafe/progress/finite-domain failures are physical outcomes, not rewritten as technical nulls.

outcome.primary: Each full model parent own official event+raw safety+progress and typed end status. Both finish -> conservative strict time improvement only if event TickBracket difference lower bound>0. One finishes/one unsafe or censored -> feasibility/status contrast only, no numeric finish-time gain. Neither finishes -> no completion or lap gain claim.
outcome.caps: Both parents own<=200 actions; no extra episode replicate. Natural stop earlier is recorded with no worst-cost credit. Exact same-command shared prefixes may be verified but not substituted for a fresh second parent.
outcome.promotion: No native/pixel/HOLDOUT/SEALED/generalization or paid-resource promotion; model-only one pair. 479 local effect is not proof this policy finishes. Even a successful model pair does not authorize native execution.
